settings.note: Allows proper rendering of pictures taken in Photo Mode and fixes auto-focus. Fixes broken lighting like bloom and other illumination effects. Breaks resolution scaling. Required for regular gameplay on game versions above 01.05 without the Disable MLAA patch.
Reduces the frequency of RSX desyncs.
Prevents some flickering when enabled with Write Color Buffers. Required for regular gameplay on game versions above 01.05 without the Disable MLAA patch.
Very minor performance increase. Prevents car reward screens from dropping to near zero FPS.

For use on game versions 01.05 and below. Enable CPU Blit Emulation while disabling Write Color Buffers and Read Color Buffers for higher FPS and no flickering, but less lighting effects and broken lighting in tunnels. Enabling all 3 settings together is not recommended.
